replies.author: HotAndCrunch
replies.body:
1. Ram literally does not increase your fps by 1. If you want good fps get a graphics card
  2. Rendezvous 3 CTW lags so much - I normally get 300 fps to avicus but I was getting 30 fps
  3. FPS lag is nothing to do with internet or the server. It is the complexity of the maps.

replies.author: Pavlo
replies.body:
I'd just like to point out that the complexity of the maps is not what creates the lag. Sure more detailed maps lag more, but they are not the cause. I've gotten 600 fps on some Avicus maps in single player, but only 150 fpd while on the server. 

Also,  RAM does increase fps, but not by much unfortunately.
